  let tractorStarted = false;

  const setupTractorBeam = () => {
    if (typeof IntersectionObserver === 'undefined') return;

    const container = document.getElementById('logo-river');
    const ufoContainer = document.querySelector('.ufo-container');
    const logoItems = document.querySelectorAll('.logo-item');
    
    if (!container || !ufoContainer || !logoItems.length) return;

    // Respect prefers-reduced-motion — skip tractor beam animation entirely
    const prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
    if (prefersReducedMotion.matches) return;

    let isVisible = false;

    const startTractorBeamEffect = () => {
      // Track the current rendered lift per DOM element (not data-uid)
      // so that the original and overflow copy each maintain independent
      // lerp/descent state — keying by data-uid caused the second copy
      // to double-apply the lerp on the first copy's already-updated value.
      const renderedLift = new Map(); // logo element → number
      const DESCENT_DURATION = 1200;
      const descentState = new Map(); // logo element → { startLift, startTime }

      const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

      // Frame-rate independent lerp: at 60fps a factor of 0.09 gives
      // ~1.2s chase. Scale by actual delta so 120Hz and 60Hz feel the same.
      const ASCEND_LERP_BASE = 0.09;
      const TARGET_FRAME_MS = 1000 / 60; // 16.67ms
      let prevTimestamp = 0;
      let lastVisibleTimestamp = 0;

      const updateLogoPositions = (timestamp) => {
        // Pause the loop when scrolled off-screen to avoid unnecessary
        // getBoundingClientRect calls and CPU/GPU work.
        if (!isVisible) {
          // Only capture the timestamp on the first invisible frame —
          // subsequent invisible frames must not overwrite it, otherwise
          // the paused duration calculation on resume would always be ~16ms.
          if (prevTimestamp !== 0) {
            lastVisibleTimestamp = timestamp;
          }
          prevTimestamp = 0;
          requestAnimationFrame(updateLogoPositions);
          return;
        }
        // On resume from off-screen, shift in-flight descent startTimes
        // forward so they don't expire from wall-clock time passing while
        // the loop was paused.
        if (lastVisibleTimestamp && prevTimestamp === 0) {
          const pausedMs = timestamp - lastVisibleTimestamp;
          if (pausedMs > 16) {
            descentState.forEach((desc) => {
              desc.startTime += pausedMs;
            });
          }
        }
        lastVisibleTimestamp = timestamp;
        const dt = prevTimestamp ? (timestamp - prevTimestamp) / TARGET_FRAME_MS : 1;
        prevTimestamp = timestamp;
        const ufoContainerRect = ufoContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
        const offsetWidth = -15;
        const beamCenterX = ufoContainerRect.left + offsetWidth + ufoContainerRect.width / 2;
        const beamWidth = 90;

        const liftByItemIndex = new Map();
        const isLiftingByItemIndex = new Map();

        logoItems.forEach((logo) => {

<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">JavaScript</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-javascript"><span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">const</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> Sentry</span><span style="color:#F97583"> =</span><span style="color:#B392F0"> require</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">'@sentry/node'</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">Sentry.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">init</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">({ dsn: </span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">'https://<key>@sentry.io/<project>'</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> });</span></span></code></pre></div></div><div class=" installation-snippet bg-alt-dark-purple flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-scroll max-w-[59.3125rem] w-full" id="react" data-docs-url="https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/javascript/guides/react/" data-astro-cid-lifyow4k><p>Grab the <a href="https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/">Sentry React SDK</a>:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">Bash</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-bash"><span class="line"><span style="color:#B392F0">npm</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> install</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> @sentry/react</span></span></code></pre></div><p>We recommend putting the Sentry initialization code into its own file and including that file as the first import in your application entry point as shown in the example below:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">JSX</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-jsx"><span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">import</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> { useEffect } </span><span style="color:#F97583">from</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> "react"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">import</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> *</span><span style="color:#F97583"> as</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> Sentry </span><span style="color:#F97583">from</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> "@sentry/react"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">Sentry.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">init</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  dsn: </span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">"https://examplePublicKey@o0.ingest.sentry.io/0"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  integrations: [</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  ],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Set `tracePropagationTargets` to control for which URLs trace propagation should be enabled</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  tracePropagationTargets: [</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">/</span><span style="color:#F97583">^</span><span style="color:#85E89D;font-weight:bold">\/</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">/</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> /</span><span style="color:#F97583">^</span><span style="color:#DBEDFF">https:</span><span style="color:#85E89D;font-weight:bold">\/\/</span><span style="color:#DBEDFF">yourserver</span><span style="color:#85E89D;font-weight:bold">\.</span><span style="color:#DBEDFF">io</span><span style="color:#85E89D;font-weight:bold">\/</span><span style="color:#DBEDFF">api</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">/</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">],</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">});</span></span></code></pre></div><p>Include the Sentry initialization file as the first import statement:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">JSX</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-jsx"><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Sentry initialization should be imported first!</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">import</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> "./instrument"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">import</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> App </span><span style="color:#F97583">from</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> "./App"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">import</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> { createRoot } </span><span style="color:#F97583">from</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> "react-dom/client"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">const</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> container</span><span style="color:#F97583"> =</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> document.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">getElementById</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(“app”);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">const</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> root</span><span style="color:#F97583"> =</span><span style="color:#B392F0"> createRoot</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(container);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">root.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">render</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(<</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">App</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> />);</span></span></code></pre></div></div><div class=" installation-snippet bg-alt-dark-purple flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-scroll max-w-[59.3125rem] w-full" id="net" data-docs-url="https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/dotnet/" data-astro-cid-lifyow4k><p>Install the <strong>NuGet</strong> package to add the Sentry dependency:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">Bash</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-bash"><span class="line"><span style="color:#B392F0">dotnet</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> add</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> package</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> Sentry</span></span></code></pre></div><p>Initialize the SDK as early as possible, like in the <code>Main</code> method in <code>Program.cs/Program.fs</code>:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">C#</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-csharp"><span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">using</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (SentrySdk.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">Init</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#B392F0">o</span><span style="color:#F97583"> =></span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Tells which project in Sentry to send events to:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  o.Dsn </span><span style="color:#F97583">=</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> "https://<key>@sentry.io/<project>"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // When configuring for the first time, to see what the SDK is doing:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  o.Debug </span><span style="color:#F97583">=</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> true</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // Set TracesSampleRate to 1.0 to capture 100% of transactions for Tracing.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // We recommend adjusting this value in production.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  o.TracesSampleRate </span><span style="color:#F97583">=</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> 1.0</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">; }))</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">{</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // App code goes here - Disposing will flush events out</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div><div class=" installation-snippet bg-alt-dark-purple flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-scroll max-w-[59.3125rem] w-full" id="go" data-docs-url="https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/go/" data-astro-cid-lifyow4k><p>Grab the <a href="https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-go">Sentry Go SDK</a>:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">Go</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-go"><span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">go</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> get </span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">"github.com/getsentry/sentry-go"</span></span></code></pre></div><p>Configuration should happen as early as possible in your application's lifecycle:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">Go</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-go"><span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">package</span><span style="color:#B392F0"> main</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">import</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#9ECBFF">	"</span><span style="color:#B392F0">log</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#9ECBFF">	"</span><span style="color:#B392F0">time</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">"</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#9ECBFF">	"</span><span style="color:#B392F0">github.com/getsentry/sentry-go</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">)</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">func</span><span style="color:#B392F0"> main</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">() {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">	err </span><span style="color:#F97583">:=</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> sentry.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">Init</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#B392F0">sentry</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">ClientOptions</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">{</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">		Dsn: </span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">"https://<key>@sentry.io/<project>"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">    EnableTracing: </span><span style="color:#79B8FF">true</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">		// Specify a fixed sample rate:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">		// We recommend adjusting this value in production</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">		TracesSampleRate: </span><span style="color:#79B8FF">1.0</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">		// Or provide a custom sample rate:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">		TracesSampler: sentry.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">TracesSampler</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#F97583">func</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#FFAB70">ctx</span><span style="color:#B392F0"> sentry</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">SamplingContext</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">) </span><span style="color:#F97583">float64</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">			// As an example, this does not send some</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">			// transactions to Sentry based on their name.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">			if</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> ctx.Span.Name </span><span style="color:#F97583">==</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> "GET /health"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">				return</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> 0.0</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">			}</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">			return</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> 1.0</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">		}),</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">	})</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">	if</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> err </span><span style="color:#F97583">!=</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> nil</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">		log.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">Fatalf</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">"sentry.Init: </span><span style="color:#79B8FF">%s</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">, err)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">	}</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">	// Flush buffered events before the program terminates.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">	// Set the timeout to the maximum duration the program can afford to wait.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">	defer</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> sentry.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">Flush</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">2</span><span style="color:#F97583"> *</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> time.Second)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div><div class=" installation-snippet bg-alt-dark-purple flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-scroll max-w-[59.3125rem] w-full" id="swift" data-docs-url="https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/apple/" data-astro-cid-lifyow4k><p>To integrate Sentry into your Xcode project, specify it in your <code>Podfile</code>, then run <code>pod install</code>:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">Swift</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-swift"><span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">platform </span><span style="color:#F97583">:</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">ios, '</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">9.0</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">use_frameworks</span><span style="color:#F97583">!</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> # This </span><span style="color:#F97583">is</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> important</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">target 'YourApp' </span><span style="color:#F97583">do</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  pod 'Sentry', </span><span style="color:#F97583">:</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">git </span><span style="color:#F97583">=></span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> 'https</span><span style="color:#F97583">:</span><span style="color:#6A737D">//github.com/getsentry/sentry-cocoa.git', :tag => '<VERSION>'</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">end</span></span></code></pre></div><p>Initialize the SDK as soon as possible in your application lifecycle, such as in your AppDelegate <code>application:didFinishLaunchingWithOptions</code> method:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">Swift</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-swift"><span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">import</span><span style="color:#B392F0"> Sentry</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // Make sure you import Sentry</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">func</span><span style="color:#B392F0"> application</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#B392F0">_</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> application: UIApplication,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#B392F0">    didFinishLaunchingWithOptions</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> launchOptions: [UIApplication.LaunchOptionsKey: </span><span style="color:#79B8FF">Any</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">]</span><span style="color:#F97583">?</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">) </span><span style="color:#F97583">-></span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> Bool</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">    SentrySDK.</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">start</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> { options </span><span style="color:#F97583">in</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">        options.dsn </span><span style="color:#F97583">=</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> "https://<key>@sentry.io/<project>"</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">        options.debug </span><span style="color:#F97583">=</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> true</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> // Enabled debug when first installing is always helpful</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // Example uniform sample rate: capture 100% of transactions for Tracing</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">        options.tracesSampleRate </span><span style="color:#F97583">=</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> 1.0</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">    }</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">    return</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> true</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">}</span></span></code></pre></div></div><div class=" installation-snippet bg-alt-dark-purple flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-scroll max-w-[59.3125rem] w-full" id="ruby" data-docs-url="https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/ruby/" data-astro-cid-lifyow4k><p>Add the <code>sentry-ruby</code> gem to your <code>Gemfile</code>:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">Ruby</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-ruby"><span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">gem </span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">"sentry-ruby"</span></span></code></pre></div><p>Configure your DSN:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">Ruby</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-ruby"><span class="line"><span style="color:#79B8FF">Sentry</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">init</span><span style="color:#F97583"> do</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> |config|</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  config.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">dsn</span><span style="color:#F97583"> =</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> 'https://<key>@sentry.io/<project>'</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  # Set a uniform sample rate between 0.0 and 1.0</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  # We recommend adjusting the value in production:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  config.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">traces_sample_rate</span><span style="color:#F97583"> =</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> 1.0</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  # or control sampling dynamically</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  config.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">traces_sampler</span><span style="color:#F97583"> =</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> lambda</span><span style="color:#F97583"> do</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> |sampling_context|</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    # sampling_context[:transaction_context] contains the information about the transaction</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    # sampling_context[:parent_sampled] contains the transaction's parent's sample decision</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#79B8FF">    true</span><span style="color:#6A737D"> # return value can be a boolean or a float between 0.0 and 1.0</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">  end</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">end</span></span></code></pre></div></div><div class=" installation-snippet bg-alt-dark-purple flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-scroll max-w-[59.3125rem] w-full" id="php" data-docs-url="https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/php/" data-astro-cid-lifyow4k><p>Install the <code>sentry/sentry</code> package with Composer:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">Bash</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-bash"><span class="line"><span style="color:#B392F0">composer</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> require</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> sentry/sentry</span></span></code></pre></div><p>To capture all errors, even the one during the startup of your application, you should initialize the Sentry PHP SDK as soon as possible.</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">PHP</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-php"><span class="line"><span style="color:#79B8FF">\Sentry\</span><span style="color:#B392F0">init</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">([</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">'dsn'</span><span style="color:#F97583"> =></span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> 'https://<key>@sentry.io/<project>'</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Specify a fixed sample rate:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#9ECBFF">    'traces_sample_rate'</span><span style="color:#F97583"> =></span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> 0.2</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // Or provide a custom sampler:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#9ECBFF">    'traces_sampler'</span><span style="color:#F97583"> =></span><span style="color:#F97583"> function</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">SentryTracingSamplingContext</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> $context)</span><span style="color:#F97583">:</span><span style="color:#F97583"> float</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        // return a number between 0 and 1</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">    }, ]);</span></span></code></pre></div></div><div class=" installation-snippet bg-alt-dark-purple flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-scroll max-w-[59.3125rem] w-full" id="laravel" data-docs-url="https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/php/guides/laravel/" data-astro-cid-lifyow4k><p>Install the <code>sentry/sentry-laravel</code> package with Composer:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">Bash</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-bash"><span class="line"><span style="color:#B392F0">composer</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> require</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> sentry/sentry-laravel</span></span></code></pre></div><p>Add Sentry reporting to <code>bootstrap/app.php</code>:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">PHP</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-php"><span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583"><?</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">php</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">use</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> Illuminate\Foundation\Application</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">use</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Exceptions</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">use</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> Illuminate\Foundation\Configuration\Middleware</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">use</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> Sentry\Laravel\Integration</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">return</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> Application</span><span style="color:#F97583">::</span><span style="color:#B392F0">configure</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#B392F0">basePath</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">: </span><span style="color:#79B8FF">dirname</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">__DIR__</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">))</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">    -></span><span style="color:#B392F0">withRouting</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#B392F0">        web</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">: </span><span style="color:#79B8FF">__DIR__</span><span style="color:#F97583">.</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">'/../routes/web.php'</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#B392F0">        commands</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">: </span><span style="color:#79B8FF">__DIR__</span><span style="color:#F97583">.</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">'/../routes/console.php'</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#B392F0">        health</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">: </span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">'/up'</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">    )</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">    -></span><span style="color:#B392F0">withMiddleware</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#F97583">function</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">Middleware</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> $middleware) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">        //</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">    })</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">    -></span><span style="color:#B392F0">withExceptions</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#F97583">function</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">Exceptions</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> $exceptions) {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#79B8FF">        Integration</span><span style="color:#F97583">::</span><span style="color:#B392F0">handles</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">($exceptions);</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">    })</span><span style="color:#F97583">-></span><span style="color:#B392F0">create</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">();</span></span></code></pre></div><p>Enable Sentry Tracing in <code>config/sentry.php</code>:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">PHP</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-php"><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Specify a fixed sample rate:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#9ECBFF">'traces_sample_rate'</span><span style="color:#F97583"> =></span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> 0.2</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// Or provide a custom sampler:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#9ECBFF">'traces_sampler'</span><span style="color:#F97583"> =></span><span style="color:#F97583"> function</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">SentryTracingSamplingContext</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> $context)</span><span style="color:#F97583">:</span><span style="color:#F97583"> float</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">    // return a number between 0 and 1</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">},</span></span></code></pre></div><p>Run this <code>Artisan</code> command to configure the Sentry DSN:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">Bash</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-bash"><span class="line"><span style="color:#B392F0">php</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> artisan</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> sentry:publish</span><span style="color:#79B8FF"> --dsn=</span><span style="color:#F97583"><</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">paste-your-DSN-here</span><span style="color:#F97583">></span></span></code></pre></div></div><div class=" installation-snippet bg-alt-dark-purple flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-scroll max-w-[59.3125rem] w-full" id="aspnet-core" data-docs-url="https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/dotnet/guides/aspnetcore/" data-astro-cid-lifyow4k><p>Add the Sentry dependency:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">Bash</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-bash"><span class="line"><span style="color:#B392F0">dotnet</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> add</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> package</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> Sentry.AspNetCore</span></span></code></pre></div><p>Configure Sentry in <code>appsettings.json</code>.</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">JavaScript</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-javascript"><span class="line"><span style="color:#9ECBFF">"Sentry"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">: {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#9ECBFF">  "Dsn"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">: </span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">"https://examplePublicKey@o0.ingest.sentry.io/0"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#9ECBFF">  "Debug"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">: </span><span style="color:#79B8FF">true</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">},</span></span></code></pre></div><p>Then add the SDK by simply calling <code>UseSentry</code>:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">C#</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-csharp"><span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">public</span><span style="color:#F97583"> static</span><span style="color:#B392F0"> IHostBuilder</span><span style="color:#B392F0"> CreateHostBuilder</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#F97583">string</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">[] </span><span style="color:#B392F0">args</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">) </span><span style="color:#F97583">=></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">    Host.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">CreateDefaultBuilder</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(args)</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">        .</span><span style="color:#B392F0">ConfigureWebHostDefaults</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#B392F0">webBuilder</span><span style="color:#F97583"> =></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">        {</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">            // Add the following line:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">            webBuilder.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">UseSentry</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">();</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">        });</span></span></code></pre></div></div><div class=" installation-snippet bg-alt-dark-purple flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-scroll max-w-[59.3125rem] w-full" id="spring-boot" data-docs-url="https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/java/guides/spring-boot/" data-astro-cid-lifyow4k><p>Grab the <a href="https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-java/">Sentry Java SDK</a>:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">XML</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-xml"><span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"><</span><span style="color:#85E89D">dependency</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  <</span><span style="color:#85E89D">groupId</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">>io.sentry</</span><span style="color:#85E89D">groupId</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  <</span><span style="color:#85E89D">artifactId</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">>sentry-spring-boot-starter</</span><span style="color:#85E89D">artifactId</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  <</span><span style="color:#85E89D">version</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">><</span><span style="color:#85E89D">VERSION</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">></</span><span style="color:#85E89D">version</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"></</span><span style="color:#85E89D">dependency</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">></span></span></code></pre></div><p>Configure your DSN in <code>application.properties</code>:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">Java</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-java"><span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">sentry.dsn</span><span style="color:#F97583">=</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">https</span><span style="color:#F97583">:</span><span style="color:#6A737D">//<key>@sentry.io/<project></span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8"># Set traces_sample_rate to </span><span style="color:#79B8FF">1.0</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> to capture </span><span style="color:#79B8FF">100</span><span style="color:#F97583">%</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">sentry.traces</span><span style="color:#F97583">-</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">sample</span><span style="color:#F97583">-</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">rate</span><span style="color:#F97583">=</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">1.0</span></span></code></pre></div></div><div class=" installation-snippet bg-alt-dark-purple flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-scroll max-w-[59.3125rem] w-full" id="vue" data-docs-url="https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/javascript/guides/vue/" data-astro-cid-lifyow4k><p>Grab the <a href="https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-javascript/">Sentry Vue SDK</a>:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">Bash</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-bash"><span class="line"><span style="color:#B392F0">npm</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> install</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> @sentry/vue</span></span></code></pre></div><p>Configure your DSN:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">JavaScript</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-javascript"><span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">import</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> { createApp } </span><span style="color:#F97583">from</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> "vue"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  app,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  dsn: </span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">"https://<key>@sentry.io/<project>""</span><span style="color:#FDAEB7;font-style:italic">,</span></span>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">app.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">mount</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">"#app"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">);</span></span></code></pre></div></div><div class=" installation-snippet bg-alt-dark-purple flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-scroll max-w-[59.3125rem] w-full" id="solid" data-docs-url="https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/javascript/guides/solid/" data-astro-cid-lifyow4k><p>To use the SDK, initialize Sentry in your Solid entry point index.jsx before you render your Solid app:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">JSX</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-jsx"><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// index.jsx / index.tsx</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">import</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> { useBeforeLeave, useLocation } </span><span style="color:#F97583">from</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> "@solidjs/router"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">});</span></span>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">if</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> (</span><span style="color:#F97583">!</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">app) </span><span style="color:#F97583">throw</span><span style="color:#F97583"> new</span><span style="color:#B392F0"> Error</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">"No #app element found in the DOM."</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">);</span></span>

<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">JSX</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-jsx"><span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">// main.js / main.ts</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  dsn: </span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">"__DSN__"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  integrations: [</span><span style="color:#F97583">new</span><span style="color:#B392F0"> BrowserTracing</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">()],</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // This enables automatic instrumentation (highly recommended),</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // but is not necessary for purely manual usage</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // If you only want to use custom instrumentation:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // * Remove the BrowserTracing integration</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // * add Sentry.addTracingExtensions() above your Sentry.init() call</span></span>

<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // We recommend adjusting this value in production, or using tracesSampler</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#6A737D">  // for finer control</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  tracesSampleRate: </span><span style="color:#79B8FF">1.0</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">  target: document.</span><span style="color:#B392F0">getElementById</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">(</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">"app"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">),</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">export default app;</span></span></code></pre></div></div><div class=" installation-snippet bg-alt-dark-purple flex flex-col gap-4 overflow-scroll max-w-[59.3125rem] w-full" id="astro" data-docs-url="https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/javascript/guides/astro/" data-astro-cid-lifyow4k><p>Just run this command to install and register Sentry's Astro integration.</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">Bash</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-bash"><span class="line"><span style="color:#B392F0">npx</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> astro</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> add</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> @sentry/astro</span></span></code></pre></div><p>And add your DSN and project config to your <code>astro.config.mjs</code> file:</p>
<div class="code-wrapper"><div class="code-header"><span class="code-language">JavaScript</span><span class="code-header-actions"><span class="hasCopiedCodeMessage" role="status"></span><button class="copyCodeButton" aria-label="Copy code"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="white" xmlns="https://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><path d="M16 1H4C2.9 1 2 1.9 2 3V17H4V3H16V1ZM19 5H8C6.9 5 6 5.9 6 7V21C6 22.1 6.9 23 8 23H19C20.1 23 21 22.1 21 21V7C21 5.9 20.1 5 19 5ZM19 21H8V7H19V21Z" fill="white" /></svg></button></span></div><pre><code class="language-javascript"><span class="line"><span style="color:#F97583">import</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8"> { defineConfig } </span><span style="color:#F97583">from</span><span style="color:#9ECBFF"> "astro/config"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">;</span></span>

<span class="line"></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#B392F0">    sentry</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">({</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">      dsn: </span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">"__DSN__"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>

<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">        project: </span><span style="color:#9ECBFF">"your-project-slug"</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">        authToken: process.env.</span><span style="color:#79B8FF">SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">      },</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">      tracesSampleRate: </span><span style="color:#79B8FF">1.0</span><span style="color:#E1E4E8">,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="color:#E1E4E8">    }),</span></span>

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const dropdownElement = document.querySelector(`#installation-dropdown-${installationInstructions?.length}`);

    if (dropdownElement) {
      let transitionTimeout = null;

      dropdownElement.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
        const inputValue = event?.target?.value;

        const nextActive = document.getElementById(inputValue);

        // Remove initial-load class on first interaction
        const initialLoad = document.querySelector('.installation-snippet.initial-load');
        if (initialLoad) {
          initialLoad.classList.remove('initial-load');
        }

        // Update footer CTA docs link
        const docsLink = document.querySelector('.footer-cta .docs-link');
        if (docsLink && nextActive) {
          docsLink.setAttribute('href', nextActive.dataset.docsUrl || '/platforms');
        }

        // Cancel any in-flight transition
        if (transitionTimeout) {
          clearTimeout(transitionTimeout);
          transitionTimeout = null;

          // Immediately finalize the interrupted transition
          const shrinking = document.querySelector('.installation-snippet.shrinking');
          if (shrinking) {
            shrinking.classList.remove('shrinking', 'active');
          }
        }

        const currentActive = document.querySelector('.installation-snippet.active');

        if (currentActive && nextActive && currentActive !== nextActive) {
          currentActive.classList.add('shrinking');

          transitionTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
            transitionTimeout = null;
            currentActive.classList.remove('shrinking', 'active');
            nextActive.classList.add('active');
          }, 1000);
        } else if (nextActive && !currentActive) {
          nextActive.classList.add('active');
        }
      });

Bash brew install getsentry/tools/sentry-wizard && sentry-wizard -i android Signup and install Sentry with just one line of code: Bash brew install getsentry/tools/sentry-wizard && sentry-wizard -i ios Sign-up and install Sentry with just one line of code: Bash npx @sentry/wizard@latest -i flutter Install Sentry with one line of code: Bash npx @sentry/wizard@latest -i reactNative Add the Sentry dependency to your .NET MAUI application: Bash dotnet add package Sentry.Maui -v 5.11.1 Grab the Sentry Python SDK : Bash pip install --upgrade sentry-sdk Configure your DSN: Python import sentry_sdk sentry_sdk.init( "https://<key>@sentry.io/<project>" , # Set traces_sample_rate to 1.0 to capture 100% # of transactions for Tracing. # We recommend adjusting this value in production. enable_tracing = True , traces_sample_rate = 1.0 , ) Grab the Sentry Node SDK : Bash npm install @sentry/node Configure your SDK: JavaScript const Sentry = require ( '@sentry/node' ); Sentry. init ({ dsn: 'https://<key>@sentry.io/<project>' }); Grab the Sentry React SDK : Bash npm install @sentry/react We recommend putting the Sentry initialization code into its own file and including that file as the first import in your application entry point as shown in the example below: JSX import { useEffect } from "react" ; import * as Sentry from "@sentry/react" ; Sentry. init ({ dsn: "https://examplePublicKey@o0.ingest.sentry.io/0" , integrations: [ ], // Set `tracePropagationTargets` to control for which URLs trace propagation should be enabled tracePropagationTargets: [ / ^ \/ / , / ^ https: \/\/ yourserver \. io \/ api / ], }); Include the Sentry initialization file as the first import statement: JSX // Sentry initialization should be imported first! import "./instrument" ; import App from "./App" ; import { createRoot } from "react-dom/client" ; const container = document. getElementById (“app”); const root = createRoot (container); root. render (< App />); Install the NuGet package to add the Sentry dependency: Bash dotnet add package Sentry Initialize the SDK as early as possible, like in the Main method in Program.cs/Program.fs : C# using (SentrySdk. Analyzes every signal to explain why your code failed, not just where.
Fixes what’s broken while you ship what’s next – generating precise, merge-ready patches.
Stops bad code before it starts bad days. Correlating PRs against real error and performance history to catch regressions before they ship.

    // Respect prefers-reduced-motion — skip tractor beam animation entirely

    let isVisible = false;

      // so that the original and overflow copy each maintain independent
      // lerp/descent state — keying by data-uid caused the second copy

      const renderedLift = new Map(); // logo element → number
      const DESCENT_DURATION = 1200;
      const descentState = new Map(); // logo element → { startLift, startTime }

      const easeOutCubic = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

      // Frame-rate independent lerp: at 60fps a factor of 0.09 gives
      // ~1.2s chase. Scale by actual delta so 120Hz and 60Hz feel the same.
      const ASCEND_LERP_BASE = 0.09;
      const TARGET_FRAME_MS = 1000 / 60; // 16.67ms
      let prevTimestamp = 0;
      let lastVisibleTimestamp = 0;

      const updateLogoPositions = (timestamp) => {
        // Pause the loop when scrolled off-screen to avoid unnecessary
        // getBoundingClientRect calls and CPU/GPU work.
        if (!isVisible) {
          // Only capture the timestamp on the first invisible frame —
          // subsequent invisible frames must not overwrite it, otherwise
          // the paused duration calculation on resume would always be ~16ms.
          if (prevTimestamp !== 0) {
            lastVisibleTimestamp = timestamp;
          }
          prevTimestamp = 0;
          requestAnimationFrame(updateLogoPositions);
          return;
        }
        // On resume from off-screen, shift in-flight descent startTimes
        // forward so they don't expire from wall-clock time passing while
        // the loop was paused.
        if (lastVisibleTimestamp && prevTimestamp === 0) {
          const pausedMs = timestamp - lastVisibleTimestamp;
          if (pausedMs > 16) {
            descentState.forEach((desc) => {
              desc.startTime += pausedMs;
            });
          }
        }
        lastVisibleTimestamp = timestamp;
        const dt = prevTimestamp ? (timestamp - prevTimestamp) / TARGET_FRAME_MS : 1;
        prevTimestamp = timestamp;
        const ufoContainerRect = ufoContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
        const offsetWidth = -15;
        const beamCenterX = ufoContainerRect.left + offsetWidth + ufoContainerRect.width / 2;
        const beamWidth = 90;

        const liftByItemIndex = new Map();
        const isLiftingByItemIndex = new Map();

        logoItems.forEach((logo) => {
          const logoRect = logo.getBoundingClientRect();
          const logoCenterX = logoRect.left + logoRect.width / 2;
          const distanceFromCenter = Math.abs(logoCenterX - beamCenterX);
          const itemIndex = logo.getAttribute('data-uid');

          if (!itemIndex) return;

          if (distanceFromCenter < beamWidth) {
            const progress = 1 - (distanceFromCenter / beamWidth);
            const liftAmount = progress * 90;

            const existingLift = liftByItemIndex.get(itemIndex) || 0;
            if (liftAmount > existingLift) {
              liftByItemIndex.set(itemIndex, liftAmount);
              isLiftingByItemIndex.set(itemIndex, true);
            }

              liftByItemIndex.set(itemIndex, 0);
              isLiftingByItemIndex.set(itemIndex, false);
            }

        logoItems.forEach((logo) => {
          const itemIndex = logo.getAttribute('data-uid');
          if (!itemIndex) return;

          // Beam target is shared across duplicate elements (keyed by data-uid)
          const targetLift = liftByItemIndex.get(itemIndex) || 0;
          const shouldBeLifting = isLiftingByItemIndex.get(itemIndex) || false;
          const wasLifting = logo.classList.contains('lifting');

          if (shouldBeLifting) {

          logo.style.setProperty('--lift-amount', `${newLift}px`);

          if (shouldBeLifting && !wasLifting) {

See token usage breakdown by model, track input vs output tokens, and identify expensive operations. See Docs Agent tracing, end to end Trace every agent run, end to end. AI agents fail across a chain of steps, not a single line of code. Agent tracing stitches every LLM call, tool execution, and handoff into one connected trace, with full prompt and response context, token counts, cost, and timing on every span. Follow the trace to the exact tool or step that went wrong, and apply agent tracing best practices to keep runs reliable as they scale. Agent tracing best practices Getting started with Sentry is simple We support every technology (except the ones we don't). Get started with just a few lines of code. Python (OpenAI Agents) JavaScript (Vercel AI) Install sentry-sdk from PyPI: Bash pip install "sentry-sdk" Add OpenAIAgentsIntegration() to your integrations list: Python import sentry_sdk from sentry_sdk.integrations.openai_agents import OpenAIAgentsIntegration sentry_sdk.init( # Configure your DSN dsn = "https://examplePublicKey@o0.ingest.sentry.io/0" , # Add data like inputs and responses to/from LLMs and tools; # see https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/python/data-management/data-collected/ for more info send_default_pii = True , integrations = [ OpenAIAgentsIntegration(), ], ) The vercelAIIntegration adds instrumentation for the ai SDK by Vercel to capture spans using the AI SDK's built-in Telemetry. Get started with the following snippet: JavaScript Sentry. init ({ // Configure your DSN dsn: 'https://<key>@sentry.io/<project>' , tracesSampleRate: 1.0 , integrations: [ Sentry. vercelAIIntegration ({ recordInputs: true , recordOutputs: true , }), ], }); To correctly capture spans, pass the experimental_telemetry object with isEnabled: true to every generateText , generateObject , and streamText function call. JavaScript const result = await generateText ({ model: openai ( "gpt-4o" ), experimental_telemetry: { isEnabled: true , }, }); That's it. Check out our documentation to ensure you have the latest instructions. Create a Sentry Account See All Platforms "Sentry played a significant role in helping us develop [Claude] Sonnet" Since adopting Sentry, Anthropic has seen: 10-15% increase in developer productivity 600+ engineers rely on Sentry to ship code 20-30% faster incident resolution read more AI observability FAQ What is AI observability? AI observability is the practice of understanding what your AI features are actually doing in production, across LLM calls, agent runs, tool executions, and the application code around them. Instead of treating the model as a black box, it connects prompts, responses, token usage, latency, errors, and cost to the rest of your application's traces and logs, so you can debug failures down to the specific call that caused them. What is LLM observability, and how is it different from AI observability? LLM observability focuses specifically on the behavior of large language model calls: prompts, completions, token counts, model latency, and cost. AI observability is broader: it covers LLM calls plus the agents, tools, retrieval steps, and custom logic that wrap them. In practice you want both, which is why Sentry tracks individual LLM calls and stitches them into full agent traces in one place. What's the difference between AI monitoring and AI observability? AI monitoring tells you that something is wrong: an error spiked, a model got slow, costs jumped. AI observability helps you understand why, by giving you the connected traces, prompts, responses, and code context behind the signal. Sentry does both: real-time alerts when something breaks, plus the debuggability to trace it to a root cause. What is agent tracing? Agent tracing follows a single AI agent run from start to finish as a connected trace, capturing every LLM call, tool execution, and handoff as a span with its inputs, outputs, token counts, cost, and timing. Because AI agents make decisions across many steps, a flat log isn't enough; agent tracing shows you the full execution path so you can see exactly which step failed or stalled. See how agent tracing works in Sentry . How do I get observability for AI agents? Add the Sentry SDK and the integration for your agent framework: OpenAI Agents, Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, LangGraph, Anthropic, Google Gen AI, and more. Sentry auto-instruments agent runs and captures invoke_agent , execute_tool , and handoff spans, so you get full AI agent observability and tracing without rewriting your agent logic. Can I monitor and trace MCP servers? Yes. Sentry gives you observability for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers : tracking tool calls, errors, latency, and usage, and connecting them into the same traces as the agents and LLMs that call them. See the guide to monitoring an MCP server to get started. Is AI observability included in Sentry's free plan? Yes. AI agent and LLM observability is available on every Sentry plan, including the free Developer plan: full tracing, token and cost tracking, and tool-execution monitoring out of the box. See pricing details .       // cached pages will fail to dynamically import the old chunk URLs.
      // Detect this and force a hard reload so the browser fetches fresh HTML

data-astro-cid-zpzoxhr3>
The team behind Sentry built and shipped the software behind
            many fine brands, a short sampling of which will no doubt
            impress and delight you. We were occasionally useful at Dropbox.
            Drew pictures at GitHub. Nodded sagely during meetings at
            Atlassian.
</p> <p class="mb-0" style="--shineUrl: url(/_astro/shine.jrCN90re.png);" data-astro-cid-zpzoxhr3>
Sentry started out as an open-source project. Our founders' goal
            was straightforward: solve their own problems with an easy way
            to fix their own mistakes. Ten years later, their two person
            passion project is the world's leading error-tracking platform
            with 200+ employees in four offices worldwide.

Explore Cookbook Docs Pricing Sign In Get Demo Get Started Working Code, Happy Customers We're so much more than error monitoring software. We're also performance monitoring software. Our platform helps every developer diagnose, fix, and optimize the performance of their code. With Sentry, developers around the world save time, energy, and probably a few therapy sessions. Sentry supports more than 100 coding languages, which means it probably supports yours. We also integrate with a whole bunch of useful tools (and a few necessary evils), including but definitely not limited to GitHub, Slack, and Jira. Numbers That Make Us Look Good Loved by millions of developers and 200K organizations across 146 countries spanning 6 continents with 190B+ events processed daily (We're still waiting on our first customer in Antarctica) and $217M raised in 6 rounds of funding (That's enough to build the Golden Gate Bridge six times, if we could take that money and time travel back to 1933) The Humans Behind the Code The team behind Sentry built and shipped the software behind many fine brands, a short sampling of which will no doubt impress and delight you. We were occasionally useful at Dropbox. Drew pictures at GitHub. Nodded sagely during meetings at Atlassian. Sentry started out as an open-source project. Our founders' goal was straightforward: solve their own problems with an easy way to fix their own mistakes. Ten years later, their two person passion project is the world's leading error-tracking platform with 200+ employees in four offices worldwide. You've Heard of Our Customers To name-drop a few… We're Everywhere Okay, not everywhere. But somewhere.
